PkixKeyDecodeTestGroup.description: A group of PKIX key-decode test cases sharing the same algorithm, parameter set, and key encoding.

keyType.description: The kind of key encoding tested: 'pkcs8' for a PKCS#8 PrivateKeyInfo (RFC 5208 / RFC 5958), 'spki' for a SubjectPublicKeyInfo (RFC 5280).

algorithm.description: The cryptographic algorithm the encoded key is for (e.g. 'ML-DSA', 'RSA', 'ECDSA', 'Ed25519').

parameterSet.description: An algorithm-specific parameter selector (e.g. 'ML-DSA-44', 'secp256r1', '2048'). Vectors within a group MUST share this value.

PkixKeyDecodeTestVector.description: A single PKIX key-decode test case. The encoded field is fed to the parser selected by the group's keyType. The result indicates expected parser behavior; this corpus tests parser acceptance only and does not assert anything about the recovered key material.

comment.description: A brief description of the test case

encoded.description: Hex-encoded bytes to be fed to the key parser.

flags.description: A list of flags categorizing the mutation or property tested

algorithm.description: The primitive tested in the test file

numberOfTests.description: The number of test vectors in this test
